navaid.name: Marina Frapa
navaid.description: Marina Frapa lies in a sheltered inlet opposite the village of Rogoznica on the Adriatic coast of Croatia, five miles SE of Primosten and 15 miles W of Trogir. A luxury, full-service marina with every conceivable facility. The marina provides 450 berths.
